definitions.explanation: A polite way to refer to a third person. More respectful than あの人 and appropriate for formal situations or when speaking about someone of higher status.

examples.japanese: あの{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
あの{方|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{会|あ}い→会う：00482_au⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have met that person before.

examples.japanese: あの{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧です。
examples.english: That person was formerly the president of this company.

notes:
あの{方|かた} is a polite pronoun for referring to a third person who is not present or who is at a distance. Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system.

POLITENESS SCALE:
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧: very informal, can be rude
- ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧: neutral
- あの{方|かた}: polite
- ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: very polite

DEMONSTRATIVE SET:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: this person (near speaker)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: that person (near listener)
- あの{方|かた}: that person (far from both)
- ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ / ⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧: which person / who

USAGE:
Use あの{方|かた} in formal situations, business contexts, or when speaking about someone deserving respect. In very formal speech, あの{方|かた}{様|さま} adds even more respect.
